name: Freed-Hardeman University
academic_ranking: Private university affiliated with the Churches of Christ, founded 1869. Primarily undergraduate and residential with roughly 2,300 total students (about 1,850 undergraduates) across five colleges. Noted by U.S. News & World Report for affordability among Southern master's-granting universities.
financial_aid: Financial aid details not confirmed from a live official source during research (fhu.edu tuition/aid pages returned HTTP 403 on 2026-07). FHU reports a $96.2M endowment (2025) and is recognized for affordability; prospective athletes should confirm merit/need-based aid and athletic scholarship packages directly with FHU financial aid and the softball staff.
facilities_notes: Softball program is based at Chalmers Clubhouse (listed as the coaching staff office location).
program_reputation: NAIA program competing in the Mid-South Conference as the FHU Lions/Lady Lions. Team social account @FHU_SB.
notes: Coaching staff verified against the softball staff directory at gofhulions.com on 2026-07. No individual staff Twitter/X handles listed; team account is @FHU_SB. Tuition and scholarship counts left null because they could not be confirmed from a live authoritative source (FHU official tuition page returned 403; Wikipedia did not list current figures).
